title: Developer Salary Explorer
source: 2026 Stack Overflow Developer Survey / MIE1624 Assignment 2
method: Cumulative threshold ordinal logistic regression; 14 liblinear L1 models (C=0.3)

single.name: Country
options: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

single.name: ICorPM
options: Both people manager and individual contributor
Individual contributor in a senior or staff-level role

single.name: Role
options: Developer advocate or developer relations professional
Developer, AI apps or physical AI
Solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or forward-deployed engineer
UX, research, or UI design professional

single.name: OrgSize
options: Just me - I am a freelancer, sole proprietor, etc.

single.name: WorkSetting
options: Hybrid (some in-person, leans heavy to flexibility)
Hybrid (some remote, leans heavy to in-person)
Your choice (very flexible, you can come in when you want or just as needed)

Professional degree (JD, MD, Ph.D, Ed.D, etc.)

Some college/university study without earning a degree
